content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Senior Resident/Tutor 2026 (III) prospectus announces 575 vacancies across 10 medical departments . The department-wise vacancy distribution is provided in Appendix-1 on pages 10 and 11. Radiotherapy has the highest number of advertised posts, followed by Radiology and Tuberculosis and Chest Diseases. The official vacancy annexure provides the detailed category-wise distribution for SC, ST, Extremely Backward Class, Backward Class, Backward Class Women, Unreserved and EWS candidates. These reservations are included within the notified 575 vacancies. Candidates must refer to Appendix-1 for the exact department-wise reservations and applicable conditions. content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board has issued the Senior Resident/Tutor 2026 (III) prospectus for preparation of the appointment panel against 575 three-year tenure posts under the Bihar Health Department. The 11-page prospectus contains the department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limits, remuneration provisions, selection methodology, application fees, online registration procedure and document verification requirements. Official Prospectus / Recruitment Notices: BCECEB Senior Resident/Tutor Notice Board

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the relevant postgraduate medical qualification in the concerned speciality, subject to the eligibility and faculty qualification rules applicable to Bihar government medical institutions. The prospectus specifies that DNB and DNB Super Speciality qualifications are to be considered according to the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 issued by the National Medical Commission. Important: Applicants holding postgraduate qualifications in more than one speciality may apply for eligible subjects separately, following the department-wise application requirements. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualification and speciality requirements. Applicants must possess valid medical registration and supporting certificates. Candidates already having completed a three-year Senior Resident/Tutor tenure in the same subject are not eligible for another tenure in that subject. Candidates who have completed three years in one subject may be considered for another eligible subject under the prescribed rules. Applicants must disclose previous employment, teaching experience and Senior Resident/Tutor appointments accurately. The prospectus provides special provisions for eligible Bihar Health Service doctors and applicants with related higher qualifications.

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit varies by category and is determined according to the Bihar Government rules. The prospectus uses 1 August 2026 as the age reference date. Age Relaxation: The prospectus allows ten years of relaxation for eligible candidates with disabilities under the applicable provisions. Other age relaxation conditions for eligible Bihar Health Service candidates and special categories will apply according to the relevant rules.

content_sections.text: The prospectus refers to a monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,15,000 for Senior Resident/Tutor tenure appointments, with separate applicable service conditions for existing Bihar Health Service doctors. content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: All listed candidate categories must pay a non-refundable counselling fee of Rs. 2,250 , plus applicable online processing charges. Payment Mode: Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or UPI. The fee is non-refundable after successful payment. Candidates must pay any applicable online transaction charges separately.

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a merit-based panel prepared according to the prescribed postgraduate qualification, academic marks, applicable experience and service-related weightage rules, followed by counselling and document verification. Online application submission and eligibility scrutiny. Preparation of the subject-wise merit panel using the prescribed evaluation criteria. Publication of the counselling/document verification programme. Verification of original educational, medical registration, category and experience certificates. Final panel formation and appointment according to the Bihar Health Department rules. The prospectus does not specify a separate competitive written examination for this recruitment. The merit assessment uses a combination of qualifying academic examination performance, postgraduate qualification and applicable experience-related marks. The exact evaluation depends on the candidate's postgraduate examination system, qualifications, earlier service and other applicable provisions. Candidates must refer to the complete merit-calculation instructions in the prospectus.

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Online registration is scheduled to start on 2 November 2026 . Candidates must complete registration, fill in the application, upload the required photograph and signature, and pay the counselling fee through the official BCECEB application facility. Apply Online: BCECEB Official Website Senior Resident/Tutor Notice Board: View Official Recruitment Section Registration Deadline: 23 November 2026, 10:00 PM. Fee Payment and Final Submission Deadline: 23 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Candidates should open the Online Portal of Senior Resident / Tutor under Health Department and select the appropriate 2026 (III) application link when available.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at bceceboard.bihar.gov.in . Open the Senior Resident/Tutor recruitment section. Select the online application facility for Senior Resident/Tutor 2026 (III). Click New Registration and enter the required personal information. Provide an active mobile number and email address and complete the separate verification-code process. Log in using the generated Registration Number and Password. Complete Department Selection and click Save & Continue. Enter the required personal details, reservation category and other applicable information. Provide the permanent and correspondence address details. Enter educational qualifications, speciality information and relevant experience details. Upload a clear colour photograph and signature according to the portal instructions. Use the application preview to check all details. Make necessary corrections before final submission. Click Final Submit & Proceed to Payment . Pay the Rs. 2,250 counselling fee and applicable processing charges. Download the Confirmation Page and Fee Receipt after successful payment. Keep the documents ready for counselling and document verification. Important: Candidates must use the correct registered mobile number and email address. The portal instructions state that these cannot be changed after successful verification during the application process.

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The application editing facility is scheduled until 24 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Only candidates who have successfully submitted their applications and completed the prescribed fee payment within the deadline are eligible to use this facility. Applicants should review their corrected application and retain the updated Confirmation Page. Corrections will not be entertained outside the notified editing window.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must produce original certificates along with one additional photocopy during counselling and document verification. Matriculation Admit Card, Marksheet or Certificate for date-of-birth proof. MBBS marksheets for all prescribed professional examinations. MBBS Passing Certificate. MBBS Attempt Certificate. Postgraduate Speciality Marksheet and Passing Certificate. Relevant Ph.D., DM, M.Ch. or M.Sc. qualification certificates, where applicable. Medical Registration Certificate. Experience Certificate, if applicable. Employer No Objection Certificate, if applicable. Current caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where required. Bihar Residential Certificate. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable. Disability Certificate, if applying under Disabled Quota. Freedom Fighter Dependent Certificate, if applicable. Four identical photographs used in the online application. Verification Slip downloaded from the Board's website, in two copies. Printed Online Application Confirmation Page. Candidates should carry all relevant supporting documents required by their reservation category, qualification and employment status. Applications and reservation claims will be assessed according to the prospectus and Bihar Government rules.

content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Appointment Tenure 2026
content_sections.text: The advertised appointment is for a three-year tenure in government medical colleges and hospitals under the Bihar Health Department. The prospectus also includes restrictions on repeat tenure appointments in the same subject and specifies that candidates must provide an affidavit regarding their previous Senior Resident/Tutor tenure. Selection through the panel does not automatically entitle candidates to permanent government service.

content_sections.text: Registration begins on 2 November 2026. The registration deadline is 23 November 2026 at 10:00 PM. Fee payment and final submission close at 11:59 PM on 23 November. The application editing deadline is 24 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. All listed categories must pay Rs. 2,250 as counselling fee. Applicants must meet the specified postgraduate medical qualifications. Reservation benefits are subject to Bihar Government rules and valid supporting certificates. Candidates must declare previous Senior Resident/Tutor appointments accurately. Applicants who have completed the prescribed three-year tenure in the same subject are not eligible for repeat appointment in that subject. Incomplete applications or forms without successful fee payment may be rejected. Hard copies are not required to be mailed to BCECEB during online application. faq.question: Q1. Is there an interview for these posts?
faq.answer: No. The interview provision has been removed, and every candidate receives a uniform 6 marks under that head.

faq.question: Q2. What score do I need to qualify?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifying score for appointment is 16 marks.

faq.question: Q3. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: A diploma is accepted only when suitable candidates are short. Diploma holders get 10 marks like PG degree holders, but are placed below them in the merit list.

faq.question: Q4. Is a DNB accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. DNB / DNB Super Speciality is treated as a valid qualification under the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulation, 2025.

faq.question: Q5. I have already done a Senior Residency. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Not in the same subject if you completed the three-year tenure. You can apply in a different subject, and your earlier work in Bihar's government or semi-government colleges earns experience marks.

faq.question: Q6. I have PG degrees in two subjects. How should I apply?
faq.answer: Submit a separate application for each department and mention this in the online form. Once selected in one subject, you cannot be selected in another.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Bihar apply?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% of the posts are for doctors with a PG degree from recognised institutions outside the state. However, applicants who are not natives of Bihar get no reservation benefit.

faq.question: Q8. Can I change my details after submitting the form?
faq.answer: You can correct entries only during the editing period ending at 11.59 PM on 24 November 2026, and only if you paid on time. Your verified mobile number and email cannot be changed.

faq.question: Q9. I am in a three-year bond. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Yes, if you were not posted as Senior Resident / Tutor, but you must bring a departmental NOC. Your time on the post counts towards the bond.
